question: Should OpenClaw establish `safetyEventTypes` plus `safetyDiagnostics.emit()` as a supported external plugin contract, and should the resulting metadata-only event history be a durable core operator surface?
rationale: This choice defines a new plugin authorization capability, durable retained data, and operator-visible safety semantics; code review cannot determine the intended permanent SDK and privacy policy.

options.title: Approve a bounded contract
options.body: Specify supported event families, retention/access policy, provenance semantics, and compatibility expectations, then request focused implementation and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep it core-only
options.body: Retain any approved internal diagnostics seams but remove the external manifest and plugin-emission API until a separate SDK proposal is accepted.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR and keep the feature request open until a maintainer sponsors the safety-observability product direction.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded contract
recommendation.body: Specify supported event families, retention/access policy, provenance semantics, and compatibility expectations, then request focused implementation and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a cross-cutting core, plugin-SDK, persisted-state, and security-observability product decision.
